name: dmf
description: Domain Modeling Made Functional in C# for any codebase: domain discovery, type-driven modeling that makes illegal states unrepresentable, Result-based workflow pipelines, DTOs and persistence, plus read-only DMF and functional-style reviewer agents. Unity-aware. Its hooks hold C# work to the skills: design and review are routed to them, a C# edit waits for an implementation skill, and a turn that changed C# runs the reviewers before it ends.
